alternatives.name: 1. GRE over IPv4
alternatives.assessment: Point-to-point routed overlay over the existing BGP transport. GRE can carry different network-layer payload types.
alternatives.cost: 24 bytes of overhead per IPv4 packet. Kernel support is loaded.

alternatives.name: 2. IPv4-in-IPv4
alternatives.assessment: A simpler IP-only tunnel with the same routed underlay. Comparative performance would require a separate trial.
alternatives.cost: 20 bytes of overhead without outer IP options. Kernel support is module available.

alternatives.name: 3. MPLS
alternatives.assessment: Label switching needs an explicitly configured label table and input interfaces. A fabric-wide design would also need a label distribution or static label plan.
alternatives.cost: 4 bytes per label. Kernel forwarding is module available and IP tunnel encap support is module available.
